sentences.text:
======================================================
 Subhash Kumar Mahto @ Subhash Kumar Son of Shivnandan Mahato  Resident of Village- Tajpur, P.S. and District- Jamui

... ...
 Versus  1. The State of Bihar  2. Rupam Kumari Daughter of Ranjit Mahato Resident of Tajpur, P.S. and  District- Jamui  ... ... Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Vijay Kumar , Advocate  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Dr.Mrityunjaya Kr.Gautam , APP  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PRABHAT KUMAR SINGH  ORAL ORDER 2 04-02-2026 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and the State .

2. Petitioner apprehends arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable under section 323 ,
504, 506, 420, 468 and 406 of IPC .

3 . As per the prosecution case , this petitioner by deceitful inducement, persuaded the complainant to open multiple bank accounts, retained her Atm cards and passbooks, and in conspiracy with co-accused fraudulently transacted lakhs of rupees.
4.

Considering the nature of accusation and gravity of offence and other circumstances of the case ,
prayer for pre- Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.6178 of 2026(2) dt.04-02-2026 arrest bail of the petitioner is rejected.

(Prabhat Kumar Singh, J) Koushik/-
